content: MySQL JSON columns cannot be indexed directly; queryable JSON fields must be pulled into generated (virtual/stored) columns with their own secondary index, and only InnoDB supports secondary indexes on virtual generated columns. Multi-value indexes (8.0.17+) can index JSON arrays via MEMBER OF/JSON_OVERLAPS/JSON_CONTAINS. If a JSON field isn't promoted to a generated column, it is effectively unqueryable at scale (full table scan + JSON_EXTRACT).
